comment: Exact sha256 of unmodified published Mach-O bytes. Hits of this host's HOME inside these files are upstream build-time debug/provenance strings, not locally authored payload. First-party files never match these digests. Do not treat this as a path allowlist. sha256 names the published bytes as downloaded; sha256_unsigned names the same bytes after `codesign --remove-signature`, because the release re-signs foundations with the operator identity and a fresh timestamp and a shipped (re-signed) binary can never hash to the published digest. Both digests pin the same artifact.

artifacts.name: aicx
artifacts.notes: Developer ID MW223P3NPX. Contains rustup stdlib debug paths from the publisher toolchain home. Bytes are not stripped or patched.
